notes.title: Memory and Prediction added to Simulation
notes.notes:
[b]Temporal Behaviour added to Simulation[/b]
[previewyoutube=VRVRtqwsXZI;full][/previewyoutube]

In this update:
[*] Memory that tracks previous plans for where to move to next.
[*] Average of remembered past plans incorporated into current decision making to allow past plans to naturally transition into present plans. (Purple lines)
[*] Prediction modelling algorithms for 3D space coordinates based on past trends.
[*] Used to factor into current decision what you might plan to do in the future based on historic trends. (Yellow lines)

notes.title: New Early Preview Pre-Alpha Build Released for January 2025
notes.notes:
Download the January 2025 Pre-Alpha Preview here free of charge: https://cheropie.itch.io/polyleague-manager-2026-pre-alpha-simulation-test-january-2025

[previewyoutube=ylhivet2Z8Q;full][/previewyoutube]

This is an early test preview which features:
[list]
[*] Spacial Reasoning algorithms
[*] Customized behaviour for players coordinating with the ball
[*] Cutstomized behaviour for defenders.
[*] Passing the ball using intelligent fuzzy logic assesments.
[*] Tackling logic (some bugs to iron out here)
[*] A demo of the match commentator (Currently just a preview, only has one context implemented thusfar, may occasionally repeat dialogues due to chosing from a small pool of implemented ones)
[*] Cutstomized audience chanting depending on which team has the ball.
[*] Press R to reset. Simulations are a chaotic system and will not play out exactly the same way twice, even from the same starting conditions.
[/list]
